structures.label: Superior vena cava
structures.function: Returns deoxygenated blood from the upper body to the right atrium.

structures.label: Inferior vena cava
structures.function: Returns deoxygenated blood from the lower body to the right atrium.

structures.label: Right atrium
structures.function: Receives systemic venous blood before it passes to the right ventricle.

structures.label: Tricuspid valve
structures.function: Controls one-way flow from the right atrium to the right ventricle.

structures.label: Right ventricle
structures.function: Pumps deoxygenated blood through the pulmonary valve toward the lungs.

structures.label: Pulmonary valve
structures.function: Controls flow from the right ventricle into the pulmonary trunk.

structures.label: Pulmonary trunk
structures.function: Carries deoxygenated blood from the right ventricle before dividing into pulmonary arteries.

structures.label: Pulmonary arteries
structures.function: Carry deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs.

structures.label: Pulmonary veins
structures.function: Return oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium.

structures.label: Left atrium
structures.function: Receives oxygenated blood from the pulmonary veins.

structures.label: Mitral valve
structures.function: Controls one-way flow from the left atrium to the left ventricle.

structures.label: Left ventricle
structures.function: Pumps oxygenated blood through the aortic valve into the aorta.

structures.label: Aortic valve
structures.function: Controls flow from the left ventricle into the aorta.

structures.label: Aorta
structures.function: Carries oxygenated blood from the left ventricle to systemic circulation.

structures.label: Interventricular septum
structures.function: Separates the right and left ventricles.
